claims: National Vietnam War Veterans Day is observed annually on March 29.
National Vietnam War Veterans Day honors the 9 million Americans who served during the Vietnam War era.
In 2026, National Vietnam War Veterans Day commemorates the 53rd anniversary of the last U.S. combat troops departing Vietnam in 1973.
The last U.S. combat troops departed Vietnam in 1973.
National Vietnam War Veterans Day events include wreath-layings at the Vietnam Veterans Memorial in Washington D.C.
The Vietnam Veterans Memorial has over 58,000 names.
A national ceremony takes place at the Vietnam Veterans Memorial in Washington, D.C.
The national ceremony has notable speakers including the Secretary of War.
The national ceremony has notable speakers including the Veterans Affairs Secretary.
Actor Gary Sinise is attending special events in Washington D.C.
Vietnam veterans are attending special events in Washington D.C.
The special events include a concert.
The special events include a ceremony.
Commemorations are held nationwide by the Veterans of Foreign Wars (VFW).
Commemorations are held nationwide by The American Legion.
National Vietnam War Veterans Day was officially established by the Vietnam War Veterans Recognition Act of 2017.
